brand_tagline: Neutral, source-linked Indian election candidate affidavits in plain language.
hero_headline: Understand Candidate Affidavits — Not Political Spin.
hero_subheadline: We convert official ECI Form 26 election filings into neutral, source-linked plain-language explanations in English, Telugu, and Hindi.
neutrality_body: Nagrik Lens does not rank, score, or endorse election candidates. Every explanation is strictly derived from official Election Commission of India (ECI) Form 26 affidavits, verified against the original sworn source, and linked directly to the exact page where the candidate declared it.
discovery_subheading: Explore sworn financial assets, educational qualifications, liabilities, and criminal antecedent disclosures.
